notes.title: Electrician Simulator VR - Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 [b]Electrician Simulator VR is OUT NOW![/b] ⚡[/h1]

The wait is over—[i]Electrician Simulator VR[/i] is officially [b]LIVE![/b] 🥳🔧 Step into the role of an electrician like never before and experience what it’s like to repair, install, and rewire in a fully immersive VR world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312719/75f1872e3cf6b06995997749b27f8eb57b0895b6.png[/img]

💡 What’s new in Electrician Simulator VR?

🔧 Fully reimagined for VR – Every mission has been redesigned from the ground up to take full advantage of immersive, hands-on gameplay.
⚡ More interactivity – Handle tools, connect wires, and fix electrical issues with precision using intuitive VR controls.
💡 New challenge system – Put your skills to the test with extra tasks that encourage creative problem-solving.
🏠 Explore detailed environments – Work on a variety of jobs, from small repairs to full electrical installations.

💥 Why VR?
Electricity isn’t something you just look at—it’s something you interact with. That’s why Take IT Studio! brought [i]Electrician Simulator[/i] to VR! Feel the weight of the tools in your hands, carefully connect wires, and experience the thrill of fixing electrical issues up close. The added immersion makes every job more engaging, whether you’re a seasoned electrician or just learning the ropes.

🛠️ A fresh take on the original experience
If you’ve played [i]Electrician Simulator[/i] before, get ready for a completely new approach. While the desktop version was all about precision and strategy, VR takes the experience to another level with real-world interactions, physical problem-solving, and a sense of scale you can’t get on a flat screen. Every mission has been tailored for VR to make sure it feels natural, rewarding, and fun!

So grab your headset, put on your work gloves, and see if you have what it takes to become a pro electrician—or maybe just avoid getting zapped! ⚡ Let us know what you think and share your experiences!

notes.title: Meet the Endless Mode
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Electricians,[/h1]

The day has finally arrived - in front of you [b]Endless Mode![/b] Endless tasks, new features and even more challenges. Many of you have been asking us to extend the gameplay time, so this update is especially for you! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/10b6b54d4a45929f20736486e4e3b83b3f94d16b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Endless Mode in a Nutshell[/h2]
From now on, the game will feature infinite procedurally generated repair missions and client house tasks. Random items will appear on the workbench - each with a different defect, and houses will have an even more diverse layout! 

The new layout of devices and apartments will make the game surprise you at every turn.

[previewyoutube=aCHk9airYsc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Unlock Pass and new rewards[/h2]
The Unlock Pass will allow you to run the gameplay at your own tempo. Repair broken equipment, go on missions and gain experience to unlock various interesting rewards and tasks. New challenges and customers with various problems are already waiting for you - the best electricians!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/e555563d4821ed85305fe095d2806e84108eb81b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Smart Devices DLC[/h2]
Endless Mode does not mean the end of work on Electrician Simulator. We are just working on [b]Smart Devices DLC[/b] - a paid DLC that will introduce new items, interesting tasks, and unique mechanics that will allow you to discover a completely different side in the work of an electrician! 

You are kindly invited to add [b]Smart Devices DLC[/b] to your wishlist! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2329870/Electrician_Simulator__Smart_Devices/

Reading your feedback and comments, we have set a goal to improve our game so that each of you can enjoy it endlessly. We believe that the new features we have introduced with this update will meet your expectations and provide you with a lot of good entertainment.


[b]See you![/b] 

[i]Take IT Studio! and Gaming Factory[/i]

notes.title: Winter Content Update
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Electricians,[/h1]

We have a Christmas devlog for you, and in it: [b]a major content update[/b], [b]a historic discount on the game[/b], and a [url=https://forms.gle/sLkwXnLmsveotxzh6][b]development Survey[/b][/url] for [b]Electrician Simulator.[/b]

The update we present in this devlog it's our collective work. Thanks to your suggestions in reviews, comments, and on Discord, we were able to prepare this [b]Christmas content[/b]. You are probably very curious about what we have prepared for you at the end of the year, so without further elaboration, we invite you to read on.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/403c24683879e047121e0b18513aaddb56d6e04f.png[/img]

[h2]Electrician Simulator Patch 1.5[/h2]
Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, it's Santa Claus, who has brought new content for you to play with! As usual, his elves played a prank on us and left some of the content as a surprise for you. Therefore, to discover all the stuff, you must play the latest update! 

[h3]Three New Missions[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Save the Snowman[/b] - One of our customers has a snowman friend that he keeps in the refrigerator so that he can survive as long as possible. Unfortunately, something happened and there is no electricity in the fridge! You need to fix this issue as soon as possible because if you fail, the snowman will disappear forever.

[*] [b]House lighting contest[/b] - One of our customers is taking part in a contest for the best house lighting. He has already put up all the decorations, but when the TV came down to record the Christmas competition, it turned out that not everything works as it should. Save your client, fix the Christmas decorations, and help him win the competition!

[*] [b]Surprise mission[/b] - In this mission, one of our old customer's returns and asks us for help again. Here you already have to discover for yourselves who it might be...[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/bdd387932c16d05585708d16a902cccd8f34e6e2.jpg[/img]

[h3]New workshop tasks[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Christmas toy train[/b] - Santa's helpers have messed up again! Unfortunately, the toy train that was prepared by them is not working. Fix the queue and save the children's Christmas!
 
[*] [b]Gift drone[/b] - Santa Claus is a wise man, so this year he's giving out presents not only with a reindeer-drawn sleigh but also with a drone! Unfortunately, one of his drones has broken down and won't fly. Repair the device in your workshop and help Santa deliver presents.

[*] [b]Robo gift[/b] - Another broken toy that was supposed to be a gift for a child. Fortunately, Santa knows the best expert in town who will help him fix what the elves broke![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/2d021d628d1bbf4d0933274663380a895a804b17.png[/img]

[h3]New items[/h3]
A whole bunch of new Christmas items are coming in the latest update. Among them are Christmas trees with lightning, candy cane-shaped lamps, a working dartboard, a working turntable, a new ceiling lamp, and a new screwdriver!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/989e62875b9e7a038edeb8496f0b9ccb51c853da.jpg[/img]

[h3]A Christmas vibe[/h3]
What would Christmas be without snow and decorations? In the latest update, the garage will be decorated with Christmas ornaments, and it will be snowing outside the window!

[previewyoutube=hAIQOyrwlPA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]DLC survey[/h2]
We are very keen for you to influence the development of the game. We are planning to create DLC that will introduce a whole lot of [b]new content[/b] and extend the game time. We'd like to ask you some questions in a Survey that will help us prepare better DLC. To participate in the survey [url=https://forms.gle/sLkwXnLmsveotxzh6]click here[/url] or click the banner below.

[url=https://forms.gle/sLkwXnLmsveotxzh6][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/e702c54dee366fa7f6cf03dfa16dd2ec5fb63383.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Historic discount on Electrician Simulator[/h2]
Christmas is a time of gift-giving and shopping. We also want to gift you something more than [b]just new content,[/b] so we have prepared a historic discount on our game for you! For the duration of the Christmas Steam sale Electrician Simulator will be [b]35% cheaper![/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/fedd9880bd16673f6f2c6397dc1834545d3e623e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Further game development[/h2]
The development of our production is what is most important to us at the moment, so in the last devlog, we presented you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1080020/view/3607976655129629619]our roadmap. [/url] Thanks to this roadmap, you will find out when you can expect new updates! 

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//35033617/9936f72456f79e1b39f0e621868ad266d9367660.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/ef1e2e8ab90dfe2afa7658b8b14706895929ec8c.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/

[b]Thank you for being with us. 
We wish you a very merry Christmas![/b]

notes.title: The most electrifying premiere this autumn!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Electricans![/h1]

[h2]Release of the Electrician Simulator is September 22nd![/h2]

By creating Electrician Simulator, we wanted to redefine the simulator genre. Prove that these games do not have to be boring and repetitive, and can attract with interesting tasks and a crazy world. We listened hard to the players' comments,corrected the inconsistencies found in the prologue version and added a whole bunch of new items and locations.

[previewyoutube=JCfCGs9Ccbg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]We collected your feedback from the First Shock which we very much appreciated, thank you! By the way we wanted to answer the most popular questions in our community:[/h3]

[b]1. Will this game be genderless? Can you pick who you would like to play?[/b]
We are writing the story elements right now and we’ve heard the players’ feedback. As much as we respect the LGBTQ+ Community, we are unable to incorporate all non-binary options due to limited time before the premiere. This is why we’ve made a decision to use gender-neutral dialogue options.

[b]2. Will there be more electric systems in the game, not only in Europe? US/Asia standards? A menu where the player can select what region, and then use that to show different color schemes, wires types and electric panel?[/b]
We have decided to place the whole game in a fictional town in order to be able to explain the differences from the real world. We’ve heard all your feedback and we are currently planning post-release support for the game. Depending on its success, we might be able to introduce DLCs with extra standards.

[b]3. Would it be possible to implement panel wiring such as motor starter panels (Star/Delta, cap-start/cap-run, DOL starters and sequence starters) this platform could be used for more than just fun, it could be used to educate electrician apprentices or people wanting to get into the electrical field?[/b]
As much as we would love to expand features and introduce as many appliances and panels as possible, we are not experts in electricity, education nor providing educational software. It is something to look at in the future, depending on the game’s success.

[b]4. Will there be VR?[/b]
Not at the moment, however it depends on the game’s commercial success.

[b]5. Is this game gonna be accurate in terms of appliances?[/b]
We are trying to introduce as many original appliances in the game as possible, including workbench items and job-related materials. Please keep in mind that this is a game and it’s supposed to be fun - some appliances may differ for gamification reasons (if an appliance is very interesting but complicated, we reduce it a bit so it doesn’t become an issue to complete a task in-game).

[b]6. Will the game support ultrawide monitors?[/b]
We are testing available solutions at the moment but are unable to confirm this feature at the moment.

[b]7. Will ES have steam cards and achievements?[/b]
Yes.

[b]8. Why does the garage look similar to Phasmophobia?[/b]
Because the same asset pack was used for the Prologue. A new garage was created for the full version of the game. The Prologue was a technological demo allowing us to check our ideas against our audience and make decisions that will benefit players. We were focused on mechanics and the joys of gameplay, as well as introducing story elements in a simulator. The garage was effectively a placeholder. And we like Phasmophobia.

[b]9. Will there be multiplayer?[/b]
No.

[b]10. Why is it called a simulator if it is not realistic?[/b]
The game is as realistic as it is possible from our perspective. Unfortunately, it is not easy to move all the real-world mechanics into games. Many games with the word “simulator” in their title are not realistic at all. The majority of principles are based on how things work in the real world, many have been changed slightly to simply make the game a game, and to provide joyful gameplay along with a pleasant experience.

[b]11. What sort of missions will we have that we haven't seen in a demo?[/b]
That’s a secret - you need to purchase the game to find out or await official media communications around the release date. We are almost certain that our original approach to this topic shall make everyone happy with the solution to this problem.

[b]12. Will there be proper wire colors in the full game as in real life every color has its meaning?[/b]
Cable color-coding is specific for different countries and regions, so it is very difficult to provide players from all around the globe with gameplay representative for their region. This is why we’ve made a decision to place the whole story in a fictional country in a fictional town with its own standards and coding.

[b]13. Can you delete the timer in the final game or give the option in the menu to turn it off?[/b]
The timer has been introduced for the players that enjoy a time-related challenge or speed runs. It does not introduce any bonuses or penalties, it is there so that players can check themselves against the timer.


[b]See you![/b]
[i]Take IT Studio![/i]

notes.title: Devlog #9 - We have a connection
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there![/h2]

After the warmly received "Electrician Simulator - First Shock", we are back to work on the full version of the game! Many things are happening in the project, and we are ready to show you the first new feature.

As you may remember from the prologue version, you could connect some electrical devices to outlets, and... they just worked! Some of you didn't like our stiff cables. We hear you, so we've added [b]physics[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lRq9BuE.gif[/img]

Now you can grab pretty every cable you see and play with it! Then plug it into the outlet and get that electricity flowing! But what if you can find only one outlet and you need to have more devices connected? That sounds like a problem.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RCoLkqE.gif[/img]

Well, not for us! You can use our newly created extension cord! Just plug those little fellas into their big brother and see how it works. But if you like to connect one extension cord to another? Well, you will have to test it on your own after the game releases (but it will not disappoint you).

We don't just pretend that our electricity system works. It [b]really[/b] works. So if you connect a few devices to our extension cord and you want to turn them off, you can just press the magic button on the cord. It's really that simple!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RXM5Hwt.gif[/img]


We also work on new workbench items, we add a placement system for light switches, lamps, and electrical devices, but we also let you change some bulbs, which you always really wanted!

Let us know what else you would like to see in our devlogs. We will try to update you a little bit more often.

Finally, we would like to share a piece of information about the upcoming game from our friends - [b]Bakery Simulator[/b]! If you are into baking pastries check it out! [b]The premiere will be on the 3rd of May, 18:00 CEST / 9:00 AM PDT[/b], let's show our friends some support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031120/Bakery_Simulator

[b]See you next month![/b]
[i]Take IT Studio![/i]

notes.title: Aftershock Devlog
notes.content:
Yesterday we were trembling, today we are shocked, tomorrow we rest.

[b][h1]89% of positive reviews! THANK YOU ALL![/h1][/b]

We are not going to lie. A serious stone has shattered the floor as we felt a relief after seeing so much positive feedback about our game and all the interest.

We want to thank you for all pointing out bugs, mistakes, typos and various technical issues. It's been collected and will be addressed and fixed shortly. Just give us a moment :)

If you happen to encounter any issues while playing Electrician Simulator - First Shock, please let us know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1781160/discussions/0/3191363272397816951/]Steam discussion thread[/url] or drop it on our [url=https://discord.gg/BwANa3XTEb]Discord Channel[/url]. It's easier to fix things you know they broke, and we are more than welcome to help with troubles.

[b]We want to use this moment to answer some frequently appearing questions:[/b]

A few people have asked: Yes, there will be a saving system in the full release.

Some of the feedback has surprised us utterly. 
Apparently, our little garage has a more exciting past than just Dad's electrical shenanigans. Thankfully we won't need to work there at night, aren't we?*

There is a lot of discussion about various equipment, practices, and systems. 
The full version will have way more equipment commonly used by electricians and more mechanics and levels. We will also continue the story of our clients as they will reoccur. 
Why would you call somebody else after the well-made job?

Job speaking - in the full version, there will be many more opportunities to screw the job. We aren't making an easy clicker here. Electricians need to use their smarts daily, so it's training time for you fellows :)

Now before we go for a well deserved weekend...

[h3][b]THANK YOU AGAIN![/b][/h3]

...and we are back fixing stuff and implementing languages on Monday, motivated by all the support!
Stay safe!

Fuze off - Take IT Studio and Gaming Factory Team!
PS. Quick reminder about the contest starting 9th January :) details [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1781160/view/3106919419853152656]here[/url]

*[i](Sadly, we need to address it here as we've been accused of intellectual property thievery by some people. This garage is a paid asset that we find a perfect fit for our game, and to our surprise - it's well known from Phasmophobia game... well, we know it now. It seems to be a good game, and we will definitely check it out soon :) )[/i]

notes.title: Electrician Simulator - First Shock is here!
notes.content:
Dear Electricians

[h3]TODAY IS THE DAY![/h3]

Today marks the day we can finally share the prologue to our game with all of you!

Dad is finally going to teach us some basics and show what an electrician’s job looks like. Just in time for Static Electricity Day! We all know that without static electricity, there would have been no electrical power supply in the world. So this is how we celebrate! 

The free Prologue Electrician Simulator is here to teach the ropes of the craft and well prepare for the real electrician job that will start soon. Dad would not miss the chance to give a hint here or there, or two, or a dozen. And incorporate bad dad humor. 

To play it, simply visit our Steam page and find a shiny, green download button.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1781160/Electrician_Simulator__First_Shock/

Or if you feel too relaxed to play today then just lay back and vibe with the gameplay stream that we will be running during the premiere :)

[b] What awaits aspiring electricians?[/b]

- Cleaning - Dad left the place a mess… and every apprentice starts with cleaning
- An immortal laptop - runs on Windows XP... but still works well for receiving jobs and buying equipment
- Workbench - a really sturdy and well-equipped table, perfect for working on electronics
- Jobs - a few fun jobs and some smart thinking about how to solve them


[b]What's after First Shock?[/b]

- Language patches! The prologue starts with English only, but dear not! The following languages will be added in a matter of a few days: Polish, French, German, Italian, Russian, Spanish and Simplified Chinese. 
WE NEED YOUR HELP! As the language versions are being implemented, we have very limited options to check the actual quality of the new content. We are looking for volunteers to help us check French, German, Italian, Russian, Spanish and Simplified Chinese - please join our Discord and contact the Community Manager if you’d like to help.

Competition! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1781160/view/3106919419853152656]Win cool prizes, details are available here [/url]

- Community - we are trembling for feedback on Discord. Join other enthusiasts of electricity and talk about anything and everything with fellow gamers

- a Full Release - the Prologue is done and the team is focusing on finishing the main game. We will let you know when it’s ready and announce a release date. 

[b]
Good Luck and Have Fun Electricians! [/b] And if you do like what you see in the prologue, please consider adding our main game to your wishlist ((It really helps us and other indie developers a lot) https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/


Yours [i]Take IT Studio and Gaming Factory Team![/i]
